conditions: The operation runs with a String name and a Boolean strict flag, and every HasBinding call it reaches completes normally.
limitations: This is the abstract reference-creation algorithm. It does not read an environment binding's value or decide every later use of the returned reference.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum or material counterexample affecting applicability.

statement: In ECMAScript 2024, GetIdentifierReference searches an environment chain by calling HasBinding at each visited environment, returns a reference based on the first matching environment, and returns an unresolvable reference if the chain reaches null.
